critical_code_review_comments: BiffRefineBody uses pydantic default `safety_flagged: bool = False` — v2 will coerce strings like 'true'/'false'/'1'/'0' to bool. The current impl rejects a garbage string 'not-a-bool' (422) which satisfies the spec, but a client passing the literal strings 'true'/'false' will succeed. Consider `strict=True` if strict typing is required.

wipe() in SafetyPlanBuilder uses window.confirm which is a hard blocker; per the code comment 'a parent under duress needs to be able to erase their plan in one tap.' Consider replacing with an inline undo-toast pattern to remove the confirm hop entirely.

onSaveSafetyPlan(null) only clears localStorage + local state — the server sync depends on the parent's debounced PUT firing after the state change. If the parent closes the tab within the debounce window, server-side plan persists until next PUT. A one-shot immediate PUT on delete would guarantee cross-device wipe.
SacoparentsPortal.jsx remains over the 700-line guideline (1424 lines). Iter73 delta is small (~15 lines), but the surrounding refactor risk keeps growing.
